name: throw
description: Throws a developer-specified exception, which can be caught with a cfcatch tag.
syntax: throw( [any message], [string type], [string detail], [string errorcode], [string extendedInfo], [any object], [any cause] )

params.name: type
params.description:
- A custom type
- Application
Do not enter another predefined type; types are not generated by CFML applications. If you specify Application, you need not specify a type for cfcatch.

params.name: detail
params.description:
Additional detail about the exception.

Often used for more sensitive information, i.e. which you may choose not to display to end users

params.name: errorcode
params.description: A custom error code that you supply.

params.name: object
params.description:
Throws a Java exception from a CFML tag.

This attribute is mutually exclusive with all other arguments of this function.

params.name: cause
params.description: The cause of the exception created with this tag. This can be a cfcatch block or a native java exception.
